scope: Pure synthetic in-memory and temporary-file checks only. No app/store, production verifier, sampler launch, model, service, network, process or Being access. Synthetic passing verifier metadata is not evidence of actual numerical replay.
adaptation: Renderer preserves all full received UTF-8 spans and twelve slots, binds v8 and explicit qualified CLI hash; no actual response read.

Recovery uses explicit receipt/export/session/CLI arguments; exact nonmanifest bytes and all retained evidence unchanged; only single Restore wrapper increments/paused allowed; no complete-outcome requirement.
Sampler requires exact owned manifest/session/generation; at most900 seconds,15–45 second interval(default30),61 snapshots; terminates on held/terminal/error and controls nothing.
